SUMMARY
Finance professional with 3+ years of experience across investment operations, middle office, and
derivatives trade support at global banks and fund administrators. Strong expertise in OTC derivatives,
prime brokerage, NAV support, T+1 settlements, and end-to-end trade lifecycle management. Proven
ability to analyze and resolve complex trade, cash, and position breaks, reduce operational risk, and
drive automation-led efficiency improvements. Actively upskilling in Python, SQL, and Power BI to
transition into data-driven investment operations and risk analytics roles.
CORE SKILLS
& Middle Office & Fund Ops: Trade booking & validation, affirmation, lifecycle events, NAV support, pricing checks, cash &
position reconciliation, break investigation, corporate actions, exception management, settlement processing, SLA
adherence, operational risk controls
& Products: TRS, IRS, CDS, Equity Swaps, Bonds, Repos, Equities
& Tools: Triana, MarkitWire, IceLink, MS Excel (Pivot, VLOOKUP), Python (basic automation), SQL (basic), Power BI (basic)
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Implemented automation of manual fund processing activities, achieving 30–50% reduction in processing time, and

portfolios.
& Performed cash, position and trade reconciliations, investigated breaks, completed root cause analysis, and ensured timely
resolution within SLA.
& Supported trade lifecycle management from trade capture through reconciliation, settlement support, and reporting.
& Performed pre-upload validation of trade and pricing data before fund accounting processing.
